Game Overview

Idle Space Miner Tycoon is a clicker title where lead a thriving space mining empire, evolving from a lone drill to massive refinery hubs. Automate operations, scale the cosmos, and harvest precious resources from celestial bodies. Embrace the challenge of strategic expansion and enjoy the thrill of building wealth in the vastness of space.
